46: _translator = None
47: _translation_lock = threading.Lock()
48: 
49: 
50: def _run(command: list[str], timeout: int = 900) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
51:     try:
52:         result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
53:     except FileNotFoundError as exc:
54:         raise RuntimeError(f"Required program is missing: {command[0]}. Install FFmpeg and ffprobe.") from exc
55:     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
56:         raise RuntimeError("Media processing timed out. Retry with a shorter clip.") from exc
57:     if result.returncode:
58:         detail = (result.stderr or result.stdout)[-1800:]
59:         raise RuntimeError(f"{command[0]} failed: {detail}")
60:     return result
61: 
62: 
63: def _duration(path: Path) -> float:
64:     result = _run([
65:         "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
66:         "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(path),
67:     ])
68:     try:
69:         duration = float(result.stdout.strip())
70:     except ValueError as exc:
71:         raise RuntimeError("Could not read audio duration. Make sure the WAV is valid.") from exc
72:     if duration <= 0 or duration > MAX_SECONDS:
73:         raise RuntimeError("Clips must be longer than zero and no more than 10 minutes.")
74:     return duration
75: 
76: 
77: def _cuda_available() -> bool:
78:     try:
79:         import torch
80:         return torch.cuda.is_available()
81:     except Exception:
82:         return False
83: 
84: 
85: def _transcribe(audio_path: Path, source_language: str):
86:     from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
87: 
88:     use_gpu = os.getenv("WHISPER_DEVICE", "cuda" if _cuda_available() else "cpu") == "cuda"
89:     compute = "float16" if use_gpu else "int8"
90:     cache_key = (WHISPER_MODEL, "cuda" if use_gpu else "cpu", compute)
91:     with _whisper_lock:
92:         model = _whisper_models.get(cache_key)
93:         if model is None:
94:             compute = os.getenv("WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE", compute)
95:             model = WhisperModel(WHISPER_MODEL, device=cache_key[1], compute_type=compute)
96:             _whisper_models[cache_key] = model
97:     language = SOURCE_CODES.get(source_language)
98:     segments, info = model.transcribe(str(audio_path), language=language, beam_size=1, vad_filter=True)
99:     rows = [
100:         (max(0.0, float(seg.start)), max(0.05, float(seg.end)), (seg.text or "").strip())
101:         for seg in segments if (seg.text or "").strip()
102:     ]
103:     return rows, info.language
104: 
105: 
106: def _get_translator():
107:     global _translator
108:     with _translation_lock:
109:         if _translator is None:
110:             import torch
111:             from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoTokenizer
112: 
113:             model_id = os.getenv("TRANSLATION_MODEL", TRANSLATION_MODEL)
114:             tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_id)
115:             model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(model_id)
116:             # CUDA/T4 inference uses fp16; CPU fallback stays fp32 for compatibility.
117:             if torch.cuda.is_available():
118:                 model = model.to("cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
119:             model.eval()
120:             _translator = (tokenizer, model, torch)
121:     return _translator
122: 
123: 
124: def _translate_batch(texts: list[str], source_code: str, target_code: str) -> list[str]:
125:     tokenizer, model, torch = _get_translator()
126:     tokenizer.src_lang = source_code
127:     results = []
128:     for offset in range(0, len(texts), 16):
129:         batch = texts[offset:offset + 16]
130:         encoded = tokenizer(batch, return_tensors="pt", padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=512)
131:         device = next(model.parameters()).device
132:         encoded = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in encoded.items()}
133:         with torch.inference_mode():
134:             tokens = model.generate(
135:                 **encoded,
136:                 forced_bos_token_id=tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(target_code),
137:                 max_new_tokens=256,
138:                 num_beams=2,
139:             )
140:         results.extend(text.strip() for text in tokenizer.batch_decode(tokens, skip_special_tokens=True))
141:     return results
142: 
143: 
144: def _srt_time(seconds: float) -> str:
145:     millis = max(0, round(seconds * 1000))
146:     hours, millis = divmod(millis, 3_600_000)
147:     minutes, millis = divmod(millis, 60_000)
148:     whole, millis = divmod(millis, 1000)
149:     return f"{hours:02}:{minutes:02}:{whole:02},{millis:03}"
150: 
151: 
152: def _write_srt(rows, path: Path) -> None:
153:     entries = [
154:         f"{index}\n{_srt_time(start)} --> {_srt_time(end)}\n{text}"
155:         for index, (start, end, text) in enumerate(rows, 1)
156:     ]
157:     path.write_text("\n\n".join(entries) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
158: 
159: 
160: async def _synthesize(texts: list[str], voice: str, rate: int, temp_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
161:     import edge_tts
162: 
163:     semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_TTS_CONCURRENCY)
164: 
165:     async def one(index: int, text: str) -> Path:
166:         path = temp_dir / f"voice-{index:05}.mp3"
167:         async with semaphore:
168:             await edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice, rate=f"{rate:+d}%").save(str(path))
169:         return path
170: 
171:     return await asyncio.gather(*(one(i, text) for i, text in enumerate(texts)))
172: 
173: 
174: def _atempo_filter(factor: float) -> str:
175:     return f"atempo={min(1.6, max(0.5, factor)):.5f}"
176: 
177: 
178: def dub_audio(audio_file, target_language: str, source_language: str,
179:               voice_gender: str, speech_speed: float, keep_background: bool) -> Iterator:
180:     """Yield stage messages followed by dubbed audio, SRT, and translated text."""
181:     outputs = (None, None, None)
182:     job_dir = None
183:     temp_dir = None
184:     try:
185:         if not audio_file:
186:             raise RuntimeError("Choose a media file and allow browser audio extraction before starting.")
187:         audio_path = Path(audio_file)
188:         if not audio_path.is_file():
189:             raise RuntimeError("The extracted audio expired. Re-select the media and retry.")
190:         if audio_path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
191:             raise RuntimeError("Extracted audio is over 200 MB. Choose a smaller clip.")
192:         if target_language not in LANGUAGES or source_language not in SOURCE_CODES:
193:             raise RuntimeError("Select a supported source and target language.")
194:         if voice_gender not in {"Female", "Male"}:
195:             raise RuntimeError("Select a voice gender.")
196:         rate = max(-20, min(20, int(speech_speed)))
197:         duration = _duration(audio_path)
198:         job_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / uuid.uuid4().hex
199:         job_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
200:         temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="opendub-"))
201: 
202:         yield "Transcribe: loading cached faster-whisper small model…", *outputs
203:         raw, detected = _transcribe(audio_path, source_language)
204:         rows = []
205:         for start, end, text in raw:
206:             start = min(start, duration)
207:             end = min(max(end, start + 0.05), duration)
208:             if end > start:
209:                 rows.append((start, end, text))
210:         if not rows:
211:             raise RuntimeError("No speech was detected. Try a clearer clip with audible speech.")
212:         source_code = NLLB_CODES.get(detected)
213:         if not source_code:
214:             raise RuntimeError(
215:                 f"Detected language '{detected}' is not supported by this translation model. "
216:                 "Choose a source language manually and retry."
217:             )
218: 
219:         yield "Translate: NLLB-200 distilled 600M, batches of 16…", *outputs
220:         target_code = LANGUAGES[target_language][0]
221:         translated = _translate_batch([row[2] for row in rows], source_code, target_code)
222:         translated_rows = [
223:             (start, end, text or original)
224:             for (start, end, original), text in zip(rows, translated)
225:         ]
226:         voice = LANGUAGES[target_language][2 if voice_gender == "Female" else 3]
227: 
228:         yield "Voice: generating segments in parallel (maximum 8)…", *outputs
229:         voice_paths = asyncio.run(_synthesize([row[2] for row in translated_rows], voice, rate, temp_dir))
230:         from pydub import AudioSegment
231: 
232:         mixed = AudioSegment.silent(duration=round(duration * 1000), frame_rate=24000).set_channels(1)
233:         if keep_background:
234:             source_bed = AudioSegment.from_file(audio_path).set_frame_rate(24000).set_channels(1)
235:             source_bed = source_bed[:len(mixed)]
236:             if len(source_bed) < len(mixed):
237:                 source_bed += AudioSegment.silent(duration=len(mixed) - len(source_bed), frame_rate=24000)
238:             mixed = source_bed.apply_gain(-18).overlay(mixed)
239: 
240:         yield "Sync: fitting each voice clip with FFmpeg atempo (maximum 1.6x)…", *outputs
241:         for (start, end, _), path in zip(translated_rows, voice_paths):
242:             slot_ms = max(80, round((end - start) * 1000))
243:             clip = AudioSegment.from_file(path)
244:             if len(clip) > slot_ms:
245:                 factor = min(1.6, len(clip) / slot_ms)
246:                 fitted = temp_dir / f"fit-{path.stem}.mp3"
247:                 _run([
248:                     "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-filter:a", _atempo_filter(factor),
249:                     "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", str(fitted),
250:                 ], timeout=120)
251:                 clip = AudioSegment.from_file(fitted)
252:             clip = clip.set_frame_rate(24000).set_channels(1)[:slot_ms]
253:             mixed = mixed.overlay(clip, position=round(start * 1000))
254: 
255:         yield "Export: writing MP3, SRT, and translated text…", *outputs
256:         stem = f"dub-{target_language.lower()}"
257:         mixed.export(temp_dir / "dubbed.wav", format="wav")
258:         mp3_path = job_dir / f"{stem}.mp3"
259:         _run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", str(temp_dir / "dubbed.wav"), "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "2", str(mp3_path)], timeout=300)
260:         srt_path = job_dir / f"{stem}.srt"
261:         _write_srt(translated_rows, srt_path)
262:         text_path = job_dir / f"{stem}.txt"
263:         text_path.write_text("\n\n".join(row[2] for row in translated_rows) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
264: 
265:         yield f"Export: ready for local MP4 mux; {len(rows)} translated segments.", mp3_path, srt_path, text_path
266:     except Exception as exc:
267:         yield f"ERROR: {exc}\n\nSelect Retry to run the job again.", *outputs
268:     finally:
269:         if temp_dir:
270:             shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
271:

11: # OpenDub — free AI video dubbing
12: 
13: OpenDub is a small, free-to-run dubbing app with two separate parts:
14: 
15: - **Gradio backend (`app.py`)** transcribes extracted audio, translates it, creates speech, and returns MP3, SRT, and TXT files.
16: - **Browser studio (`dist/index.html`)** extracts audio with ffmpeg.wasm, keeps the original media on your device, then muxes the dubbed MP3 into an MP4 locally while copying the source video stream without re-encoding.
17: 
18: The pipeline uses faster-whisper `small`, NLLB-200 distilled 600M, and Edge TTS. No paid API keys are required. Edge TTS does require internet and sends translated text to Microsoft's service. The supported target languages are Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, and English.
19: 
20: ## Five-step quick start (Colab backend)
21: 
22: 1. **Open the notebook.** Open [`opendub_colab.ipynb`](https://colab.research.google.com/github/moonedition7-alt/PlayGround/blob/main/opendub_colab.ipynb) in Google Colab. In **Runtime → Change runtime type**, select a T4 GPU when one is available.
23: 2. **Launch the backend.** Run the notebook cells from top to bottom. It installs FFmpeg and the Python dependencies, configures faster-whisper for GPU float16 (CPU int8 fallback), and launches Gradio with `share=True`. The first job downloads model weights and caches them for the session.
24: 3. **Copy the backend URL.** Copy the public `https://....gradio.live` URL printed by the last cell. The URL is temporary and accessible to anyone who has it; do not use a shared session for private media.
25: 4. **Open the browser studio.** Serve `dist/` locally or host it on a static web host. For local use, clone this repository on your computer and run:
26:    ```bash
27:    python3 -m http.server 3000 --directory dist
28:    ```
29:    Then open <http://localhost:3000>. The studio loads `@gradio/client` and ffmpeg.wasm from public CDNs; no frontend build step is needed.
30: 5. **Connect and dub a test clip.** Paste the Gradio URL into **Gradio backend URL**, click **Test connection**, choose a clear 10–30 second clip, select languages and voice options, then click **Create dub**. Download the MP4, MP3, SRT, and translated TXT when complete.
31: 
32: The browser uploads only an extracted mono WAV to Gradio. The source video/audio stays in the browser and is used for local MP4 muxing. Files over 200 MB and clips longer than 10 minutes are rejected. The MP4 video stream is copied without re-encoding; audio-only inputs produce an MP4 container with dubbed audio but no video track.
33: 
34: ## Local backend
35: 
36: Requirements: CPython 3.11, FFmpeg (including `ffprobe`), internet access for model downloads and Edge TTS, and several GB of disk/cache space. A GPU is recommended; CPU fallback is supported but can be slow.
37: 
38: ```bash
39: # Ubuntu/Debian
40: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg libsndfile1
41: 
42: python3.11 -m venv .venv
43: source .venv/bin/activate
44: python -m pip install --upgrade pip
45: pip install -r requirements.txt
46: HOST=127.0.0.1 python app.py
47: ```
48: 
49: Open <http://127.0.0.1:7860>, then use that URL as the backend URL in the studio. To make the local backend reachable from another machine, configure a trusted network or tunnel; do not expose this unauthenticated prototype publicly. To create a temporary Gradio share link, launch with `SHARE=true python app.py`.
50: 
51: For CUDA, install a PyTorch build compatible with your CUDA runtime. The app selects CUDA and float16 automatically when available. `WHISPER_DEVICE` and `WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE` can override the faster-whisper device and compute type. Models are cached by their respective libraries under the normal Hugging Face cache location.
52: 
53: ## Hugging Face Spaces
54: 
55: This repository includes Gradio Space metadata in the README front matter, with `app.py` as the entry point. The Space installs Python dependencies from `requirements.txt` and system packages from `packages.txt` (`ffmpeg` and `libsndfile1`). A free CPU Space may not have enough memory or compute for model downloads and inference; GPU access is recommended. Once the Space is running, paste its URL into the browser studio and click **Test connection**.
56: 
57: The app has no user accounts, authentication, durable job isolation, or quotas. A public Space or Gradio share link can be used by anyone who can reach it. Review hosting, model, dependency, and Edge TTS terms for your use case.
58: 
59: ## Processing details and limitations
60: 
61: - faster-whisper `small` uses beam size 1 and voice activity detection. Transcription and translation models are cached after loading.
62: - NLLB-200 distilled 600M translates in batches of 16 with two beams; GPU inference uses fp16.
63: - Edge TTS segment synthesis runs concurrently with a maximum of eight requests.
64: - FFmpeg `atempo` fits voice segments to their subtitle timing slots, capped at 1.6×; pydub places the clips and optionally overlays lowered original audio.
65: - The original audio option lowers and mixes the full source audio track, so original speech may remain audible. It is not source separation.
66: - There is no voice cloning or speaker diarization. Select a synthesized voice gender in the browser.
67: - Temporary work files are removed when a backend job ends. Completed MP3, SRT, and TXT files remain under `outputs/` on the backend; MP4 is assembled and downloaded by the browser.
68: - Browser extraction and MP4 muxing require a modern browser and network access to the ffmpeg.wasm CDN. The initial download of the FFmpeg WebAssembly core may take a little time.
69: 
70: ## Optional Docker backend
71: 
72: ```bash
73: docker build -t opendub .
74: docker run --rm -p 7860:7860 \
75:   -v "$PWD/outputs:/app/outputs" \
76:   -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
77:   opendub
78: ```
79: 
80: The image includes FFmpeg. Models are downloaded on first use and are not baked into the image.
81: 
82: ## Project files
83: 
84: ```text
85: app.py                 Gradio audio-only inference backend
86: dist/index.html        Browser studio and local media processing
87: requirements.txt       Python backend dependencies
88: packages.txt           Hugging Face Spaces system dependencies
89: opendub_colab.ipynb    Colab launcher (Gradio share link)
90: Dockerfile             Optional backend container
91: ```
92: 
93: This is a prototype, not a hosted commercial service. Free GPUs and session availability are not guaranteed. Check the licenses and terms of all models and services before use.

## Objective
- Replace the dubbing prototype with a free AI video-dubbing app using a Gradio backend and separate mobile-first browser frontend.
- Review integration and run a 30-second end-to-end test if the environment permits.

## Requirements
- Use faster-whisper `small` with GPU float16, beam size 1, and VAD; NLLB-200 distilled 600M in fp16 with batches of 16 and 2 beams; cache models; cap parallel Edge TTS at 8.
